_doc: Vectors of one table (the file name is the table id).

cells: the cell of the row whose key column holds key and of the column column must equal want. key is a number in the unit of the key column (or the English text of a text key), want a number in the unit of the column, the English text of a text cell, or null for an empty cell. A number matches at the relative error tol (default 1e-9).

Typical-value table: the cells below are values that two or more sources agree on, the two standard rows (IEC 60028 copper, IEC 60889 aluminium) and the cells that the research left empty because its sources disagree (null).
